description: This file defines a final class `JsonJsonifiableSerializer` extending `AbstractJsonifiableWithDittoHeadersSerializer`. The class provides serialization and deserialization methods for JSON objects using string-based Ditto JSON representation, integrating with the Eclipse Ditto framework and Akka actor system.

classes.name: JsonJsonifiableSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Eclipse Ditto Jsonifiables using string-based JSON and integrated with Akka system, extending an abstract serializer class and marked as NotThreadSafe.

methods.name: JsonJsonifiableSerializer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer with an ExtendedActorSystem, unique identifier, manifest provider, and format string.

methods.name: serializeIntoByteBuffer
methods.description: Serializes a given JsonObject into a ByteBuffer by encoding its string representation.

methods.name: deserializeFromByteBuffer
methods.description: Deserializes data from ByteBuffer into a JsonValue by decoding it into a JSON string.
